title: Adopted source-closure mapping
description: The independently versioned, adopted citizen through which source closure enters calculation (ADR-0014 decisions 1-2). It pins one source-family declaration version, names the member and closure fact types, names the closure identity key that carries the family horizon (ADR-0017 decision 2), and declares the single affirmative admission condition. The condition vocabulary is closed: exactly one matching current closure finding whose value is literal boolean true admits the family; there is no truthy, presence-only, or caller-supplied variant (ADR-0014 decisions 3-4). The admitted symbol must equal the declaration's authorized subtotal; a broader symbol is a composition defect rejected at load (ADR-0016 decisions 3-4).
